So last Friday my friend Dani convinced me to go to this karaoke place downtown, and I’ll just say I wasn’t exactly dressed for it. I wore the nice jacket, the one with the tiny hole in the sleeve that I swear nobody notices. We got there around nine and the place was packed. Dani put our names on the list and, to my horror, signed us up for a duet. “It’ll be fun,” she said. It was not fun. I forgot every lyric in the second verse, the screen froze, and a guy at the bar started clapping out of pity. But afterward we got fries and laughed so hard I nearly cried, so I’d call it a success.
